name: Insert Channel Section
description: Tool to create a new channel section for the authenticated user's YouTube channel. Use when organizing channel content into sections like featured playlists, recent uploads, or featured channels.

type.description: The type of channel section. Required field that determines the section's category. Use 'singlePlaylist' for a single playlist, 'multiplePlaylists' for multiple playlists, 'multipleChannels' for featured channels, 'recentUploads' for recent uploads, etc.

title.description: The section's title. Only valid for 'multiplePlaylists' or 'multipleChannels' types. Maximum 100 characters. Cannot contain angle brackets (< or >).

position.description: The section's position on the channel page (zero-based index). Position 0 is the first section, position 1 is the second, etc. If not specified, the section is added to the end.

snippet.description: The snippet object contains details about the channel section including its type, title, and position.

channels.description: List of channel IDs to feature in the section. Required when type is 'multipleChannels'. Cannot include your own channel ID.

playlists.description: List of playlist IDs to include in the section. Required when type is 'singlePlaylist' (exactly one ID) or 'multiplePlaylists' (one or more IDs).

contentDetails.description: Content details for the channel section.

schema.description: Request to create a new channel section.

name: Insert Comment Reply
description: Tool to create a reply to an existing YouTube comment. Use when responding to user comments or engaging in conversations on videos.

parentId.description: The ID of the parent comment being replied to. This is the comment that the new reply will be attached to.

textOriginal.description: The text content of the reply comment. This cannot be empty and will be posted as a reply to the parent comment.

name: Create Live Broadcast
description: Create and schedule a live broadcast owned by the connected YouTube channel.

title.description: Title of the live broadcast (1-100 characters).

enableDvr.description: Whether viewers can use DVR controls during the broadcast.

categoryId.description: YouTube video category ID for the broadcast.

enableEmbed.description: Whether the broadcast may be played in an embedded player.

enableAutoStop.description: Whether the broadcast stops automatically after its bound stream becomes inactive.

enableAutoStart.description: Whether the broadcast starts automatically when its bound stream becomes active.

recordFromStart.description: Whether YouTube starts recording automatically when the broadcast goes live.

scheduledEndTime.description: Optional ISO 8601 scheduled end time; it must be later than scheduledStartTime.

excludedRegionCodes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region codes where the broadcast is blocked.

globalConfig.description: Make the broadcast globally available except in excluded regions.

regionCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region code where the broadcast is available.

regionIntervals.description: Regions where the broadcast is available. Time intervals are omitted because YouTube does not support them for upcoming broadcasts.

regionsConfig.description: Make the broadcast available only in the specified regions.

availabilityConfig.description: Optional global exclusions or region-specific availability for the upcoming broadcast.

scheduledStartTime.description: Future ISO 8601 date-time when the broadcast is scheduled to start; a timezone is required.

enableMonitorStream.description: Whether to enable the private monitor stream used for testing and broadcast delay.

enableClosedCaptions.description: Whether HTTP POST closed captions are enabled. YouTube marks this setting as deprecated.

broadcastStreamDelayMs.description: Monitor-stream broadcast delay in milliseconds. Requires enableMonitorStream=true.

onBehalfOfContentOwner.description: For authorized YouTube CMS users, the content owner on whose behalf to create the broadcast.

selfDeclaredMadeForKids.description: Whether the channel owner designates this broadcast as made for kids.

onBehalfOfContentOwnerChannel.description: Channel linked to onBehalfOfContentOwner. Both CMS parameters must be supplied together.

name: Create YouTube Live Stream
description: Create a YouTube live-stream ingestion resource and return its connection settings.

frame_rate.description: Frame rate of the inbound video.

description.description: Optional stream description, up to 10000 characters.

is_reusable.description: Whether the stream can be bound to multiple broadcasts.

ingestion_type.description: Protocol used to send the stream to YouTube: rtmp, dash, or hls.

on_behalf_of_content_owner.description: For an authorized CMS user, the content owner on whose behalf to create the stream.

on_behalf_of_content_owner_channel.description: Channel linked to on_behalf_of_content_owner. Both CMS parameters must be supplied together.

name: Create Playlist
description: Tool to create a new YouTube playlist on the authenticated user's channel. Use when organizing videos into collections or building curated playlists.

title.description: The title of the new playlist. This is a required field.

description.description: The playlist's description. Provides additional context about the playlist content.

privacyStatus.description: The playlist's privacy status. 'public' makes it visible to everyone, 'private' restricts access to the owner and specified users, 'unlisted' makes it accessible via link but not publicly listed. If not specified, defaults to YouTube's default setting.

name: Add Video to Playlist
description: Tool to add a video to a playlist by inserting a playlist item. Use when organizing videos into playlists or building curated collections.

videoId.description: The YouTube video ID to add to the playlist (typically an 11-character string).

position.description: The position (zero-based index) where the video should be inserted in the playlist. Position 0 is the first position, position 1 is the second, etc. The position value must not exceed the current number of items in the playlist (if a playlist has 3 items, valid positions are 0-3). Specifying a position beyond this range will result in a badRequest error. If not specified, the video is added to the end of the playlist.

playlistId.description: The ID of the playlist to add the video to. You can retrieve playlist IDs using the YOUTUBE_LIST_USER_PLAYLISTS action.

name: Bind Live Broadcast
description: Bind an owned live broadcast to a live stream, or unbind it when streamId is omitted.

name: Delete caption track
description: Permanently deletes an owned caption track after explicit confirmation with `confirmDelete: true`.

name: Delete Channel Section
description: Deletes a YouTube channel section by ID, subject to permission. The result reports whether deletion succeeded; HTTP 400, 403, and 404 are returned as structured failures.

name: Delete Comment
description: Deletes a YouTube comment by ID, subject to authorization. The result reports whether deletion succeeded; HTTP 400, 403, and 404 are returned as structured failures.

name: Delete Live Broadcast
description: Permanently delete an owned YouTube live broadcast after confirmation.

name: Delete Playlist
description: Delete a YouTube playlist owned by the authenticated user or channel after explicit confirmation. The result reports whether deletion succeeded; certain API errors are returned as structured failure results.

name: Delete Playlist Item
description: Tool to delete a playlist item (remove a video from a playlist). Use when removing specific videos from playlists.

name: Delete Video
description: Tool to delete a YouTube video owned by the authenticated user/channel. Use when you need to permanently remove a video from YouTube. Requires explicit confirmation via `confirmDelete: true` to prevent accidental deletions. The video must exist and be owned by the authenticated channel.

name: Get Channel Activities
description: Gets recent activities from a YouTube channel including video uploads, playlist additions, likes, and other channel events.

name: Get channel ID by handle
description: Retrieves the YouTube Channel ID for a specific YouTube channel handle.

name: Get Channel Statistics
description: Gets detailed statistics for YouTube channels including subscriber counts, view counts, and video counts. Channels can be identified using their ID, handle (e.g., @Google), or username.

name: Get Playlists by ID
description: Retrieves one or more playlists by their YouTube playlist IDs.

name: Video Details Batch
description: Retrieves multiple YouTube video resource parts in a single batch call. Use when you need cohort-level metrics for many videos to reduce quota usage and latency.

name: Get Video Rating
description: Retrieves the ratings that the authorized user gave to a list of specified videos. Use when you need to check if a user has liked or disliked specific videos.
